newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling weaker vs dlr in calm trade.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling weaker vs dlr in calm trade.

text.p: Continued buying interest from foreign investors pushed the Kenyan shilling down marginally against the dollar, commercial bank dealers said on Monday.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.14 against the dollar from 54.05 on Friday, while against the pound the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 88.57 from 88.12.
"Demand is coming in. We're now selling at 54.55 from 54.35," a dealer said. Dealers said the market was stable.
The money market was liquid with overnight rates quoted at 8 percent unchanged.
